suggestedRules: Count each stable named individual skeletal-muscle concept once in the unique denominator.
Do not count muscle groups, parts/heads, side instances, meshes, scene bindings or product memberships as additional individual-muscle concepts.
Record left/right as instances unless the authoritative source defines a distinct concept; do not duplicate canonical IDs by side.
Keep variants as separate records and decide whether each belongs in the denominator based on the frozen authority-level rule.

Exclude cardiac/smooth muscle and non-muscle tissue from the skeletal-muscle target; document boundary decisions for pharynx/larynx, facial/masticatory/ocular/tongue muscle groups, pelvic floor, accessory/variant muscles.
Allow one stable concept ID to have multiple evidence-backed product memberships; sum unique stable IDs separately from membership rows.
